Title text 'England productivity by local authority'

Subtitle text 'Local authority district productivity (colour); Strategic/Combined Authority boundaries overlaid for context - these authorities have no productivity figure published at their own aggregate level. Source: ONS, Subregional productivity: labour productivity indices by local authority district, released 19 June 2025.'
